purpose: Teach: 抹殺/卑劣/撃退/狙撃/弛緩/摂理/拘置/朝方

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、ウイルスを抹殺する治療法を医療チームで研究します
lines.en: Ren — our medical team is researching treatment protocols to combat this virus.
lines.style: Clear, measured delivery. Slight pause before 'our medical team' to establish professional authority. Steady eye contact. No softening, but not harsh.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、卑劣な医療詐欺被害者の救済を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes — and our team handles cases of medical fraud and exploitation with care.
lines.style: Quiet conviction. Deliberate pacing on 'exploitation.' A slight pause that underscores the weight of these cases. Steady shoulders.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 感染症を撃退する院内対策を、貴院、なさってますね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital has strong infection control measures in place, doesn't it, Doctor?
lines.style: Thoughtful, genuine question. Slight hesitation before speaking, like he's choosing words carefully. Respectful but not deferential. Seeking to understand.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、敵性ウイルスを狙撃するように的を絞った治療を医療チームで進めます
lines.en: Yes — we target our treatment approach with precision, the way you'd focus on a specific threat.
lines.style: Deliberate metaphor. Slight emphasis on 'precision.' Calm throughout. A teacher explaining something important to an attentive student.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 筋肉弛緩剤の使用は、貴院、慎重ですね、先生
lines.en: Your hospital is quite cautious about muscle relaxant use, I've noticed.
lines.style: Quiet observation, not accusation. Gentle curiosity underlying the statement. Pause before 'noticed' — like he's been thinking about this. Respectful tone.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、自然の摂理に従った緩和ケアを医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes — our palliative care follows natural principles, managed by our full medical team.
lines.style: Slow, intentional pacing. Weight on 'natural principles.' A slight softness creeping in. Not explaining, but allowing understanding to settle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 警察の拘置所内の医療支援を、貴院、されてますね、先生
lines.en: I understand your hospital provides medical support in police detention facilities too.
lines.style: Careful phrasing. Slight pause after 'understand.' Almost cautious — not probing, but noticing something that matters. Respectful distance in the voice.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、朝方の救急救命を医療チームで担当します
lines.en: Yes — we handle emergency medical care in the early mornings and beyond as needed.
lines.style: Steady, closing the conversation without finality. A quiet acknowledgment of difficult hours. Composed but present. Voice trails slightly on 'as needed,' implying continuity.
